end.parentNote: Riya practised explaining “many in the one” using harvest festivals, shared values, food, dress and language examples. They connected different festival forms with common ideas such as gratitude, sharing and celebrating together. At home, ask them to make a two-column chart showing one shared idea and two regional examples.
